title: cuscuta gracilior var. rubella
intro: Cuscuta gracilior var. rubella, commonly known as Dodder, is a type of parasitic flowering plant that belongs to the Convolvulaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Cuscuta gracilior var. rubella include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
